projects.description: An application that imports public YouTube metrics, updates a dashboard and suggests the next content experiment. projects.title: Resume Match AI
projects.description: An eight-stage workflow connecting job requirements to evidence in a résumé. I compared lexical search and optional models across 36 internal synthetic cases: identical labels, with higher CPU latency for the models. Lexical search is the default; this evaluation does not establish quality in real hiring processes.

projects.title: Credit Risk Classification
projects.stack: Python · scikit-learn · Neural networks · Collaborative project
projects.description: A study developed with Gustavo Pereira, comparing models on Home Credit and recording a separate replication on UCI. The validation-selected MLP achieved 0.7757 ROC-AUC on 4,377 test records, versus 0.7174 for logistic regression. Probabilities are not calibrated; no production deployment is claimed.
